race.comment: FAST FREDDIE (11) showed good early muster and fought on to finish third last start over 1200m at Ballarat, which followed a good fresh run when it took a horse who looks like he has gone to a new level since being gelded to beat him. Peak fitness now and draw looks good, so expect him to go close. THINKING SENSATION (1) has won two of four this time, the latest a strong one-length win in BM66 grade at Coleraine. Has his share of weight here, but going too well to dismiss. MISS ELLANEOUS (10) scored two back at Bordertown but was below her best last time at Ballarat. This is an easier assignment than that, though, and she comes up with the inside alley. HEAVENLY EAGLE (2) has raced in better company than most of these and has placed in 4 of 6 fresh runs (2 wins).
